interpretation: For every probability mixture supported on the exact 197-column pool, the ensemble-averaged balanced program-label mass distribution has total-variation distance from uniform balanced labels strictly greater than the displayed rational lower bound.
scope: This is a finite-pool classical program-label mass bound, equivalently a dephased program-register trace-distance bound. It is not a Choi-state trace-distance or channel diamond-distance bound, and it does not extend to arbitrary continuous couplings; the same 197-column dual has a separately Arb-certified positive uniform-ray escape.
